hist-med-01-c1.text: Yale University, Open Yale Courses (Paul Freedman, HIST 210). Lecture 19 - Charlemagne (HIST 210, The Early Middle Ages, 284-1000). Open Yale Courses, Yale University.
hist-med-01-c1.quote: Charlemagne, crowned emperor in Rome by Pope Leo III in 800, made strides in reestablishing the Roman Empire
hist-med-01-c1.claim: In 800 CE, Pope Leo III crowned Charlemagne, King of the Franks, Emperor of the Romans.

hist-med-04-c3.text: Britannica Editors (1998). Gerard of Cremona. Encyclopedia Britannica.
hist-med-04-c3.quote: was a European medieval scholar who translated the works of many major Greek and Arabic writers into Latin.
hist-med-04-c3.claim: Christian scholars came to translate Arabic texts into Latin.

hist-med-06-c1.text: Britannica Editors (1998). Hagia Sophia. Encyclopedia Britannica.
hist-med-06-c1.quote: It was built as an Eastern Orthodox church between 532 and 537 ce under the direction of the Byzantine emperor Justinian I.
